Calm refined editorial travel companion, warm ivory #F7F7F2 background, dark charcoal Japanese sans-serif type, forest green #245B48 primary, pale sage chips, thin neutral borders, 16px radii, restrained shadow, spacious readable typography. Consistent 4-item bottom navigation for authenticated main screens: ホーム / ガイド / 履歴 / 設定, with small line icons and current section forest green. No bottom navigation on auth flow screens and full-screen settings subpages. Japanese labels crisp and legible, short authentic text, large touch targets. This app uses GPS and pre-researched place knowledge; NEVER include camera, capture, AR, image recognition, viewfinder, live scenery feed, leaderboard, gamification, adverts, technical API implementation language, token codes, or credit counters. Illustrated maps may be design representations, not geographic claims. Use no tourist photographs in UI.

screens.name: 06-guide
screens.title: ガイド
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, edit target. Edit reference image 1 (LocalVoice guide) using reference image 2 only for the map style. Keep the same portrait aspect ratio, edge-to-edge screen without a physical phone, warm ivory background, forest green, pale sage, crisp large Japanese typography, status bar, and 4-tab bottom navigation ホーム / ガイド / 履歴 / 設定 with ガイド selected.
Reorganize the guide as an AUDIO-PLAYING screen with a visible map in the upper approximately one-third of usable screen, then a concise story card, player, and commands. Header compact: ガイド, green ガイド中 chip, 徒歩, small 一時停止 and 終了 controls. Map is an illustrated geographic design example of 宮島 coast, blue sea and green land, a blue current-location dot with accuracy halo, short green recorded movement line with a visible gap (do not imply navigation). Highlight a soft pale amber REGION labeled 今の話題 for a regional story, not a landmark pin. Put 宮島 and 桟橋 labels, bottom mini-map attribution © OpenStreetMap contributors · OpenFreeMap, discrete top-right 全画面 icon/button; reserve space so text is readable. Map occupies about 30-35 percent, not whole screen.
Below map white story card: category 街・暮らし, location 宮島, title 「地名に残る、土地の記憶」, short two-line sample text 「地名には、昔の暮らしの手がかりが残っています。名前の由来から、この地域の話をたどってみましょう。」. This is illustrative copy, do not invent historical facts. Quiet 「出典・詳しい説明 ›」 link.
Player is visibly PLAYING: pause icon, text 「音声で案内中」, seek bar and 「0:18 / 0:42」, small 「1.0×」. Compact three large easy command buttons 「もっと詳しく」「関連の話を増やす」「次の話」, plus an unobtrusive chip 「この話題はもう十分」. No giant empty whitespace or lengthy paragraphs. Do not introduce camera, AR, photos, games, navigation directions, provider/model names, credit counters or subscription advertising. Overall calm polished consistent mobile UI. Every Japanese label clean and legible.

screens.name: 07-guide-detail
screens.title: ガイド詳細・出典
screens.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, edit target. Edit this existing LocalVoice expanded guide/detail screen. Preserve the portrait edge-to-edge phone screen aspect, ivory/forest-green/sage design language, status bar, large Japanese fonts, and bottom nav with ガイド selected. This is the expanded reading state of the new map-and-story guide screen: small compact header 「ガイド」 with ガイド中, 徒歩, 一時停止, 終了. Keep a collapsed narrow map preview underneath around 12-15 percent of usable screen: 宮島 coast in green/blue, current dot and short green track, pale amber region labeled 今の話題, unobtrusive attribution © OpenStreetMap contributors · OpenFreeMap, small 「地図を広げる」. Below prioritize a readable expanded story sheet. Header category 街・暮らし and location 宮島; exact title 「地名に残る、土地の記憶」. Body sample: 「地名には、昔の暮らしの手がかりが残っています。名前の由来から、この地域の話をたどってみましょう。」 Then clearly indicate 「地域の小話」 and short note 「事前に調べた地域の知識をもとに案内しています。」 No invented local historical fact. Audio player remains actively playing: pause icon, 「音声で案内中」, 0:18 / 0:42, 1.0×. Sources section heading 「出典」, two sample source rows 「地域の資料」「地名の解説」 external-link icons, subtle badge 「表示例」 so sample attribution isn't represented as a verified actual citation. Main footer command 「説明を閉じる」 followed by two compact commands 「関連の話を増やす」「次の話」. Keep the full reading content neatly legible, no overcrowding. No camera, AR, photograph, model names, fantasy icons, route navigation, or unnecessary empty whitespace. Map shrinks in this reading state rather than competing with text.
screens.refinement: Edit only the narrow map preview in this LocalVoice guide detail screen. Preserve every other element, all Japanese text, the story card, audio player, source rows, buttons, status bar, bottom navigation, portrait dimensions and styling exactly. The CURRENT LOCATION dot on the green recorded track must be BLUE with a light-blue accuracy halo, consistent with the main guide. Remove the amber center dot that currently makes 今の話題 look like a specific point; instead show only a soft translucent pale-amber AREA with a subtle dashed edge and the existing label 今の話題. The topic represents a regional story, not a landmark. Keep the 地図を広げる button and © OpenStreetMap contributors · OpenFreeMap attribution. Do not change any other content or layout.

screens.name: 08-map
screens.title: 現在地・移動履歴の地図
screens.prompt:

Redesign bottom white sheet as an active AUDIO PLAYER plus useful map controls, around bottom one-third: heading 「音声で案内中」 and concise title 「地名に残る、土地の記憶」, pause button, seek bar 「0:18 / 0:42」, speed 「1.0×」. Update this LocalVoice settings screen to include the new rich-voice choices while preserving portrait aspect, edge-to-edge status bar, ivory white background, forest green accents, sage, readable Japanese fonts, rounded cards and bottom navigation with 設定 selected.
